notes: Modified cash basis, governmental funds Total column (p3-4) used; beginning 5,273,368.51 + excess 499,919.11 = ending 5,773,287.62. Interfund transfers (70,000 GF to Activities) are eliminated in the Reclassification column so top-level transfers are null; the School Nutrition Fund is shown among the governmental funds so there is no business-type section. Local receipts 1,954,897.62 and County receipts 253,749.32 (p4) are split using the fund schedules, which tie exactly: Local = General/Depreciation column 1,944,582.89 (GF local receipts 1,963,791.69 less interest received 22,936.41 and interest on taxes 5,821.64, which the statement shows under Interest, plus GF non-revenue receipts 9,549.25) + School Nutrition donations 750 + Cooperative dual credit 9,564.73; County = Special Building property taxes 233,885.39 + GF fines 16,570.99 + ESU 3,292.94. The Interest line 142,032.16 is split: interest on taxes 5,821.64 + 876.30 to property tax, the rest investment income; the Activities line 129,499.63 is split per the Activities budget schedule (p9) into activity receipts, donations and interest. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from budget-to-actual schedule (p6); General Fund spending from the object-level Schedule of Cash Disbursements of Operational Expenses (pp14-18), not the function-level budget schedule (p7), to avoid double counting; it includes the 70,000 transfer shown as other financing (-70,000) inside its printed total. Activities Fund recorded account by account from the detailed schedule (p19; only accounts with activity this year), not the budget schedule (p9); its Transfers & Adjustments total column of 70,000 matches the transfer in from the General Fund. Student Fee Fund had no disbursements. Co-op Fund dual credit receipts are charges for services, as the Statement of Activities (p2) shows them. 2024 comparative columns and p20 (FY2024 activities schedule) ignored. Some budget_final values are per budget column and may be absent for object lines budgeted at function level. Read pages 1-20 of 20
